body.heading: Where in the world is North Macedonia?
paragraphs: North Macedonia is a country in Southern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of North Macedonia is Skopje.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in North Macedonia is Macedonian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of North Macedonia is the Macedonian denar.

body.heading: How big is North Macedonia?
paragraphs: North Macedonia covers about 26,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Lake Ohrid is one of Europe's oldest and deepest lakes, and its town of churches and a lakeside fortress is called the 'Jerusalem of the Balkans'.
Near Skopje, Matka Canyon's emerald river winds between cliffs — take a boat to the Vrelo underwater cave and spot eagles overhead.
